name: Somu Delivery Badge for WooCommerce
author: somu548

sections.description:
Somu Delivery Badge for WooCommerce helps store owners display estimated delivery dates directly on product pages.

Features:

  • Estimated delivery date calculation
  • Configurable processing days
  • Configurable delivery days
  • Weekend exclusion support
  • Custom badge title
  • Custom badge description
  • Custom date format
  • Custom badge icon upload
  • Enable or disable badge display
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Delivery Badge to configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated.

Can I customize the badge text?

Yes. The title, description, icon, and date format can be configured from the settings page.
